clue.text: Man with capital pursuing a way to get married?

indicators.note: pursuing means coming behind, so this piece follows the a

parts.note: Man with a capital M is the Isle of Man, giving the island word

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a man with money might be the route to marriage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' looks like a person, but with its capital it is the Isle of Man. A church's central walk is the route a bride takes to be married.
explanation.definitionFit: The bride walks up the church's central passage to her wedding, so it is a route to marriage.

clue.text: Really busy, left out cooking the duck

indicators.note: out means the letter for left is thrown out of the fodder
cooking means being concocted, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A busy cook leaves out nothing while roasting the duck.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove L from REALLY BUSY ('left out') and rearrange ('cooking'). Aylesbury is a breed of duck from the Buckinghamshire town.
explanation.definitionFit: The Aylesbury is a large white domestic breed of duck named after an English market town.

clue.text: Takes a turn loading fish into vessel

indicators.note: loading into means placing within, so the fish goes inside the vessel

parts.note: SS stands for steamship
to troll is to fish by trailing a line

explanation.surface: A fisherman takes his shift loading the catch onto a boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fish' is the verb troll; 'Takes a turn' means goes for a walk.
explanation.definitionFit: To go for a leisurely walk is to take a turn about the place.

clue.text: Distinctive spirit, albeit briefly seen, in French art

indicators.note: seen in means appearing within, so the short word sits inside the French

parts.note: es is French for (thou) art

indicators.note: briefly means cut short, leaving the clipped informal spelling of the word

parts.note: though means albeit, even if

explanation.surface: A distinctive spirit, if only fleetingly, can be found in French painting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'art' is the old verb (thou art), French tu es, not painting; 'briefly' trims THOUGH to THO.
explanation.definitionFit: The characteristic spirit or guiding beliefs of a community or era.

clue.text: Upbeat stories Saki originated during voyage out East

parts.note: ana is a collection of anecdotes or stories

indicators.note: during means one piece sits within the other
out means the letter for East is dropped from the voyage word

parts.note: a cruise is a sea voyage

indicators.note: where Saki originated is its starting letter

explanation.surface: The writer Saki's tales were first conceived on a trip to the East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' drops the E, and 'during' puts the S that Saki starts with inside what is left, giving CRUSIS. An anacrusis is the unstressed upbeat note before the first bar.
explanation.definitionFit: In music and verse, an anacrusis is the unstressed lead-in note or syllable, the upbeat before the first strong beat.

clue.text: Endeavour to work for a time in a dry environment

indicators.note: environment means surroundings, so the dry letters surround the work word

parts.note: TT is teetotal, abstaining from drink
to temp is to work for a short time

explanation.surface: Someone tries to take temporary work somewhere alcohol-free.
explanation.definitionFit: An effort or try at doing something is an endeavour.

clue.text: Too lax, somehow, beginning to look after this amphibian

indicators.note: after means coming behind, so the first letter of look comes last
somehow means in some way, so these letters are arranged afresh
the beginning of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: Someone too relaxed begins to care for a pet amphibian.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mexican salamander that keeps its larval gills is a famous amphibian.

clue.text: It's known only to connoisseurs in Paris

definitions.text: It's known only to connoisseurs in Paris

parts.words: It's known only to connoisseurs in Paris
parts.note: describes something rare and exotic, in a French word, that only the discerning would know

explanation.surface: Something is known only to Parisian experts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in Paris' tells you the answer is a French word, borrowed into English for rare and choice.
explanation.definitionFit: A French borrowing for rare, exotic or obscure, appreciated only by experts.

clue.text: Qualm making us wait, say, for — apothecary

definitions.meaning: a moral doubt that makes one hesitate
a unit of weight used for example by an apothecary, twenty grains

explanation.surface: A doubt makes the pharmacist keep us waiting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wait' sits next to 'say', hinting at weight: the word is also a small apothecaries' weight of 20 grains.
explanation.definitionFit: A moral misgiving that makes you hesitate, and also an old chemist's unit of weight.

clue.text: Brush dirt off range

definitions.meaning: an extent or span, as in a broad compass

explanation.surface: Someone brushes the dirt off the kitchen range.
explanation.definitionFit: To clean with a brush is to broom; extent or scope is also the noun sense.

clue.text: US city slum harbouring resistance movement

indicators.note: harbouring means holding inside, so the city and slum enclose the letter

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles
a ghetto is a run-down slum district
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A slum in an American city shelters an underground resistance group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'movement' looks like the resistance movement of the surface, but it is a musical movement, a larghetto being a fairly slow one.
explanation.definitionFit: A larghetto is a piece or section of music played fairly slowly, a common symphonic movement.

clue.text: Cut baron, possibly, for serving on board

definitions.text: Cut baron, possibly, for serving on board

parts.words: Cut baron, possibly, for serving on board
parts.note: a baron of beef is a large joint; slicing it for serving on a board or table is what is described

explanation.surface: A nobleman is cut down for service aboard ship.
explanation.walkthrough: A baron of beef is a big roasting joint; 'on board' suggests a ship but means a carving board or table.
explanation.definitionFit: Slicing a roast joint into portions at table is the classic sense of the verb.

clue.text: Act dishonestly, getting bread for young boxer?

definitions.meaning: to swindle someone by passing off something worthless
literally trading a puppy, such as a young boxer dog, for money (bread)

explanation.surface: Someone cheats, raising cash on behalf of a promising young fighter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boxer' suggests a fighter but is the dog breed; 'bread' is slang for money.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to swindle by selling something worthless, literally trading a young dog for cash.

clue.text: Social climber's advantage following successful period

indicators.note: following means coming after, so the advantage word comes second

parts.note: being up is a period of success, as in ups and downs
a start, as in a head start, is an advantage

explanation.surface: A social climber profits after a run of good fortune.
explanation.definitionFit: A parvenu who has risen suddenly in status and behaves arrogantly is called this.

clue.text: Seaman suitably occupied, say, descending rock face

indicators.note: say means spoken aloud, so the phrase is heard rather than read

parts.note: an AB (able seaman) doing what suits him is an AB sailing

explanation.surface: A sailor, suitably employed, is climbing down a cliff.
explanation.walkthrough: AB is an able seaman; 'AB sailing' sounds like the rope descent.
explanation.definitionFit: Lowering yourself down a cliff on a doubled rope is the climbing technique.

clue.text: The French fellow to import legal measure of milk

indicators.note: to import means to bring inside, so the French article takes in the legal measure

parts.note: le is French for the
an act is a law passed by parliament
Al is a man's name, a fellow

explanation.surface: A Frenchman wants to bring a bill in to regulate milk.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is an adjective: lacteal means relating to milk.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacteal is an adjective meaning relating to or resembling milk, from Latin lac.

clue.text: Quality associated with Lear's first poems — it's attractive

indicators.note: first means the opening letter of the word

parts.note: odes are lyric poems
tone is a quality, as of sound or voice

explanation.surface: Edward Lear's early verse has a charming quality.
explanation.walkthrough: 'attractive' means magnetic: a lodestone is natural magnetite.
explanation.definitionFit: A naturally magnetised piece of magnetite pulls iron to it, so it is literally attractive.

clue.text: New lock, say — protection for hens due to hatch?

definitions.text: protection for hens due to hatch?

indicators.note: new means made afresh, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A new lock is fitted to protect the hens that are soon to hatch.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'hens due to hatch' are chicks still in the egg, and the yolk sac nourishes and surrounds them.
explanation.definitionFit: The membrane bag of nourishment in an egg feeds the developing embryo of a future hen.

clue.text: We may wax this, using poetic language

definitions.meaning: to wax this way is to speak enthusiastically, an idiom
expressed in the manner of song or verse

explanation.surface: We may grow eloquent using poetic language.
explanation.definitionFit: Expressing feeling in a songlike, poetic way; the idiom 'wax' with it means gush.

clue.text: Spoke informally in church at Teddington

indicators.note: in means the letters lie within the words that follow

explanation.surface: Someone talked casually in a church in Teddington, a London suburb.
explanation.walkthrough: Teddington is a suburb of south-west London.
explanation.definitionFit: To speak informally and casually is to talk idly.

clue.text: Reactionary woman listened to English advancing

parts.note: Di is a woman's name

indicators.note: advancing means moving forward, so the letter for English goes earlier in the word

parts.note: heard means listened

explanation.surface: A conservative woman paid attention to English moving forward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'advancing' moves the E forward to the front of the listening word, making EHARD; the solver may expect English to be added rather than moved.
explanation.definitionFit: A hardliner who resists all change is a die-hard, a stubborn conservative.

clue.text: Junior counsel's line in reckless mischief?

parts.note: a devil is a junior barrister doing work for a senior
RY is the abbreviation for railway, a line

explanation.surface: A junior barrister's speech amounts to reckless mischief.
explanation.walkthrough: A devil is a junior counsel who works for a leader in English law; the held text had another clue run into it.
explanation.definitionFit: Wild, wicked mischief or naughtiness is the work of the devil.

clue.text: Type of humour in article in French that initially outraged America

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
que is French for that

indicators.note: initially means the first letter

parts.note: US is the United States, America

explanation.surface: A kind of humour in a French piece first angered Americans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'humour' is not comedy but a body fluid: the aqueous humour fills the front of the eye.
explanation.definitionFit: The aqueous humour is the watery fluid in the eye, so the word names a type of humour.

clue.text: Chief moral qualities of John : Henry Newman?

definitions.meaning: the four principal virtues: prudence, justice, temperance, fortitude
the good qualities belonging to John Henry Newman, who was a cardinal

explanation.surface: The question is what John Henry Newman's main moral strengths were.
explanation.walkthrough: John Henry Newman was a 19th-century English churchman made a cardinal, so his virtues are a cardinal's virtues. The colon is a stray mark in the source.
explanation.definitionFit: Prudence, justice, temperance and fortitude are the principal virtues, called cardinal from Latin for hinge.

clue.text: Powder produced by old firm in California

indicators.note: in means the old firm sits inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for company, a firm

explanation.surface: A powder is made by a long-established Californian company.
explanation.definitionFit: The ground seed of the cacao tree is sold as a brown powder for drinks.

clue.text: Drive off quietly in middle of dance

indicators.note: in middle of means placed within the other word

parts.note: a reel is a lively Scottish dance
p is piano, the musical direction for quietly

explanation.surface: Someone slips quietly away in the middle of a dance.
explanation.definitionFit: To force back or ward off an attack is to drive it away.

clue.text: No pal joined in this growing group

definitions.text: No pal joined in this growing group

parts.words: No pal joined in this growing group
parts.note: joining 'no pal' gives nopal, a prickly-pear plant, a member of this family of growing things

explanation.surface: Nobody friendly joined this expanding circle.
explanation.walkthrough: Join 'No pal' to make nopal, a prickly pear; the group it belongs to is plants, which grow.
explanation.definitionFit: The nopal or prickly pear is one of the spiny succulent plants of the family Cactaceae.

clue.text: Hope to let out a type of lens

indicators.note: out means put out of order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone hopes to rent out a camera lens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'let out' reads as renting, but only 'out' is the signal; 'let' is part of the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-focus lens that magnifies distant subjects is used in photography.

clue.text: Porter admits member with daughter extremely loftily, it's claimed

indicators.note: admits means lets in, so the drink takes the limb inside

parts.note: porter is a dark beer, an ale
a leg is a limb, a member of the body

indicators.note: extremely means taking the extreme letters of the word

explanation.surface: A hotel porter lets in a man and his daughter, supposedly very haughtily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Porter' looks like a doorman but is the beer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something said to be so but unproven is reportedly the case, as claimed.

clue.text: Maker of hose left for new start in 1 ac

indicators.note: for new start means the opening letter is replaced by another

parts.note: the answer to 1 across

explanation.surface: Something leaves to make a fresh beginning in a church passage.
explanation.walkthrough: The A starting AISLE (1 across) is replaced by L. Lisle is a fine cotton thread used for stockings.
explanation.definitionFit: Lisle thread is a smooth cotton yarn from which stockings and socks are knitted.
